_comment: HAND-AUTHORED and NOT generated. A virtual parent with no clrType, no documents and no values (dependency-updates PRD
D-O14). Its id is the onboarding page's setup-redirect query string (e.g. installation_id=123&setup_action=install),
passed as the grid's parentId so the query DependencyOnboardingRows narrows to the installation it names, the way
ForgeAccounts' id scopes my-accounts. DependencyOnboardingScopeActions.OnLoadAsync scaffolds it for ANY id: an
installation of someone else, a malformed one and one that does not exist must load alike (D-O13), and the id is
never trusted beyond narrowing the viewer's own list. Read is granted to the authenticated role only.
